mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 65 degrees and a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city is recognizing October as Community Planning Month to highlight the work of our planners, and residents are encouraged to look into the tri-shaw Bike program at the Senior Center for free, scenic rides on the Military Ridge State Trail.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Art Bar Happy Hour, and Hop Haus trivia all happening today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.

In a noteworthy update from the weekly police report, officers responded to a retail theft on September 21 where a suspect was identified via surveillance video after stealing candy from a local retailer.
You can enjoy today's Flavor of the Day, Chocolate Heath Crunch, which is available now until the store closes at 10 PM.
